configurations.name: dev
configurations.//1: Absolute path to npm: Node was installed after this machine's shells were started, so a process holding a stale PATH cannot resolve a bare `npm`. Forward slashes and the 8.3 short name avoid both JSON escaping and the space in 'Program Files'.
configurations.//2: autoPort is false because the port is not arbitrary. Supabase's Site URL and redirect allow-list are set to http://localhost:5173 (see supabase/config.toml and the README); an OAuth callback on a different port would not match.
